purpose: Test whether the eta=0 memory tangent has a scale- and redshift-dependent shape that cannot be reduced to a pure growth-amplitude rescaling, and quantify the component orthogonal to standard cosmological tangent directions before any joint observational fit.

dependency.policy_if_not_certified: Do not execute or interpret the fingerprint map on the old/default ODE solution. First resolve the linear perturbation solver limit.
dependency.solver_policy: Use exactly the solver tolerance, perturbation step-size, and start-time settings certified by the final v0.62 smooth-limit audit.

eta_tangent.definition: R_D(k,z)=d ln D(k,z)/d eta at eta=0

amplitude_only_null.purpose: Reject the interpretation that memory only rescales the overall growth amplitude.

redshift_shape_null.model: At each k remove the best constant-in-z component.
redshift_shape_null.purpose: Measure genuine temporal shape rather than an amplitude shift.

scale_shape_null.model: At each z remove the best constant-in-k component.

standard_cosmology_tangent_challenge.derivative_policy: Use symmetric finite differences around the frozen cosmology, with fixed predeclared parameter steps stored in the executable before results are read.
standard_cosmology_tangent_challenge.design_matrix: Columns are d ln D(k,z)/d theta_i evaluated on the same fixed k-z grid.
standard_cosmology_tangent_challenge.projection: R_eta_perp=(I-P_theta) R0 using an unweighted Euclidean projection on the fixed grid for the theory-only test.

numerical_gates.lambda_limit_convergence: For each fixed grid point, abs[R(0.3125)-R(0.625)] <= abs[R(1.25)-R(2.5)] unless both differences are below 1e-6.
numerical_gates.repeatability: The final R0 map must agree under the certified step-size/start-time control at normalized RMS < 1e-3.

classification_policy.note: No observational significance threshold is claimed in v0.66. This is a theory-only identifiability test.

observational_followup_if_distinct.joint_parameter: one shared eta across all probes
observational_followup_if_distinct.goal: Test whether the same nonzero eta explains the redshift-dependent lensing and growth response after standard cosmological parameters are marginalized.

anti_tuning: Do not alter the fixed k-z grid, tangent-amplification sequence, standard-parameter list, projection definition, or classifications after reading the v0.66 result. If the v0.62 smooth-limit dependency fails, v0.66 remains preregistered but is not executed until a certified linear solver configuration exists.
